name: codex-auto-pilot
description: Thin guidance for fully verified release-ready PRs or proven production delivery.

interface.shortDescription: Reach PR_READY or SHIPPED in one task
interface.longDescription: Guides both pr and ship through the same fully verified release readiness. PR_READY stops before merge; SHIPPED also releases and proves production. Clarifies unresolved decisions with Batch Grill Me, using repository tools without a receipt harness.
defaultPrompt: $auto-pilot pr <goal or PR>. Use ship to also release and verify production; both modes require full release readiness.
